<!-- Open one of these for every request, whatever you expect the answer to be:
     the issue is the record of the request, its evaluation and the decision.
     An agent fills in Evaluation and stops (docs/features.md); the owner
     decides. Rough is fine — an agent will sharpen the stories.

     If the decision can't be made until another issue is done, make the first
     line: Blocked by #N
     Labels: `feature` and one priority (docs/triage.md) -->

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: the capability, not the implementation. -->

## Problem

<!-- What can't be done today, and who notices. What prompted the request. -->

## Stories

<!-- One to four, each sized to one PR. Personas: Reader, Owner, Agent,
     Integrator (docs/features.md). Acceptance criteria are observable from
     outside: something a reviewer can run or look at. -->

### Story 1 — <short name>

**As a** <persona>, **I want** <capability>, **so that** <benefit>.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] **Given** <state>, **when** <action>, **then** <result>
- [ ] **Given** <state>, **when** <action>, **then** <result>

## Out of scope

<!-- What this request explicitly doesn't ask for. -->

## Evaluation

<!-- An agent fills this in (docs/features.md → Evaluating a request), then
     adds `needs-decision` and stops. -->

- **Scope fit:**
- **Duplicates or overlap:**
- **What it would touch:**
- **Cost and risk:**
- **Alternatives:**
- **Recommendation:**

## Decision

<!-- The owner's call, copied here from their comment before any work starts:
